input.content: Write an eight-bar melody in C major in ABC notation. Use 4/4 meter, L:1/8, a moderate tempo, and a single piano voice. Output a complete tune beginning with X:1 inside an abc code block.
Compose a short gentle waltz in G major using ABC notation. Use M:3/4, L:1/8 and eight bars. Include the X:, T:, M:, L:, Q:, and K: headers and return only one abc code block.
Write an eight-bar folk melody in D minor as ABC notation. Use 4/4 meter and a mix of quarter and eighth notes. Include all tune headers beginning with X:1. Do not insert blank lines inside the tune.
Compose a cheerful eight-bar jig in D major in ABC notation. Use 6/8 meter, L:1/8, and one melodic voice. Include X:, T:, M:, L:, Q:, and K: headers. Return the complete tune in one abc code block.

Compose eight bars of a calm piano melody in F major, M:4/4 and L:1/8, in ABC notation. Include a few rests and varied note durations. Begin the tune with X:1 and include all required headers in one abc code block.
